data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The minimal regression-test plan cannot be responsibly ordered without first resolving whether WorkflowReplayState.digest is downstream-consumed (SCR_005/SCR_006). The plan is therefore: Phase 0 (cheapest investigation): grep for WorkflowReplayState.digest consumers. Phase 1 (ordered by blast radius conditional on Phase 0): if digest IS consumed, Priority 1 is _reset() guard test, Priority 2 is lease-mismatch refusal test; if digest is NOT consumed, Priority 1 is lease-mismatch refusal test, Priority 2 is _reset() guard test. Phase 2: (3) unimported functions or deletion, (4) context receipt guard, (5) torn-tail gate, (6) census delta.","counterconditions":[{"case":"A maintainer rejects Phase 0 as over-engineering and demands a single ordering, making this plan impractical","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The grep for digest consumers is ambiguous (e.g., consumed in some configurations but not others), failing to resolve the branch","eval":"observation"},{"case":"A downstream consumer exists but is itself untested, making the blast radius of _reset() guard still speculative even after Phase 0","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The ordering principle is that the blast-radius ranking between the top two gaps is contingent on a single empirical fact (is digest downstream-consumed?) that cannot be resolved from the evidence alone. The RESPONSIBLE plan is therefore to make the cheapest investigation (grep) the first step, and branch the ordering based on its result. This avoids committing to a potentially wrong priority assignment. The remaining gaps (3-6) are stable regardless of the Phase 0 result: routing rot > recovery failure > partial coverage > observability discrepancy.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
